name: tech5
tagline: Recreation of the idTech 5 engine from Xbox 360 builds
description: tech5 is a community effort to recreate the idTech 5 game engine — the tech behind RAGE and Wolfenstein: The New Order — by reverse-engineering the original Xbox 360 builds. It is a game engine preservation project that unpacks how a modern (for its era) id engine was structured, decompiled, and reconstructed. For reverse engineers and game preservationists, it is a rare look inside one of the industry's classic engines.
highlights: Recreates the idTech 5 engine used by RAGE and Wolfenstein: TNO
A serious game engine preservation effort
Deep-dive into the structure of a classic id engine
curatorNote: idTech 5 was a famously ambitious engine, and reconstructing it from console builds is no small feat. This is the kind of preservation work that keeps classic game tech alive and learnable.
